metadata.reviewer_type: practising power-systems engineer, isolated blinded re-review
metadata.reviewer_identity: one of the same two power-systems engineers
metadata.isolation_protocol: One of the same two engineers re-read ONLY the repository-relative `audit/matcher_fn/sample_records.json`, without the README, any other audit file, manuscript, Git history, prior review, or expected aggregate. For all 100 records the engineer classified independently: `false_negative` only if frozen execution/code/output evidence shows an engineering-equivalent correct answer was actually produced and matcher/parser alone missed it; `genuine_error` if the program/result/semantics is wrong; `ambiguous` if evidence is insufficient. Generated code was not re-executed; matcher and parser outputs were supporting evidence, not verdicts.
